He gathers nobility, vast wealth, items of great power, knowledge lost to the ages, and exceptionally talented females around him as he plots and plans – preparing to set off on an epic journey that will go down in history as a new legend. Everyone was avoiding her, but Ryosuke was taught to treasure women so he offered his help by letting her dry off at his home. He would go on to become lifelong friends with a loyal mercenary, the partner of a beautiful magus who was cold as ice, the savior of a mysterious disfigured dark-elf girl with a talent for the Breath, and the unlikely caregiver for a feisty young maiden. 22047.synopsis:
She was a peerless genius in the way of medicine, holding the Medicine King Cauldron in her hand.
Once she transmigrated, she became a lowly little medicine s*ave in dispensary.

22303.synopsis:
Su Xiaoying saw Su Mu and a certain president’s intimate photos. So he called the president father.
Su Mu was scared that his heart and liver trembled, and he quickly hugged his son.
Su Mu: “Don’t call him dad.”
The president pinched his little face. “If you don’t let him call me, then you call me.”

22815.synopsis:
Pet shop owner Tang Wan was accidentally reborn into an interstellar world. When he opened his eyes, he found himself automatically married to a vegetable via the StarNetwork. A social status worth ten billion yuan; but with an unconscious husband, he was unable to withdraw any money. Tang Wan held the empty position of the First Gentleman, but was, in fact, a poor man.
In order to secure his future livelihood, Tang Wan was bound to the “Earth Pet System” and returned to his old business, with the goal of saving money, getting a divorce, and looking for a second spring!
After thousands of years of evolution, Earth’s energy depletion had long been abandoned to the distant corners of the Milky Way. All of the animals in the galaxy had evolved tremendously, and little furry cute ones only lived in textbooks. When Tang Wan and his cute little ones appeared, they became the treasures of the whole universe! The pet shop soon became famous in the interstellar world, and the whole universe lined up to be cat s*aves~
Finally surviving past the compulsory marriage period, Tang Wan happily took off the diamond ring worth billions: he can finally sell it for money!
However, Tang Wan could never have imagined that when he sat down at the dining table on a blind date with some fresh meat, the vegetative partner that he had come to an agreement with would suddenly open his eyes.
Gong: I heard you sold your wedding ring for one billion yuan?

23071.synopsis:
27-year old veteran adventurer Aiga James was once the center of the Hero’s party. However he specialized in the [Training] skill which is no longer necessary now that all his teammates have grown strong. Unable to keep up with his companions, he was forced to quit the party.
However, because he had made a great contribution to the party till now, he received a small「Fief」as a retirement bonus.

25119.synopsis: To reward Meng Fan for his bravery before his heroic death, the cosmos rewarded him with a ‘system’, sending him back in time to three months ago, alive.

28191.synopsis: Yue’s life in the suburbs with his 5 dogs.

31007.synopsis:
The first time they met, all the other noble women scurried away in an attempt to distance themselves from him as much as possible. Only Ye Huaiyang remained rooted to the spot, unable to tear her gaze away from Chu Jinglan.
The fifth time they met, he threatened to take her life away; and yet, she fearlessly shifted herself closer to him; easily succeeding in planting a kiss fully on his lips before sighing in satisfaction – she is now happy; and can die without regrets.
The ninth time they met, the two of them were forced to hide in the bookshelf. Grabbing the opportunity to cop a feel, she managed to tease him till he felt as though his entire body was ablazed.
Subsequently, the two of them were finally wed to each other. He wanted to overthrow the Emperor and claim his rightful place, so she accompanied him on his treacherous journey without complaint, diligently removing every obstacle in his way. And when the critical moment finally arrived, Ye Huaiyang set in place the biggest trap she had ever set in her entire life; and bravely marched to her solitary death.
Chu Jinglan, who had always been calm and restrained, angrily grabbed hold of her – “What did you take me for? Did you think you could just decide to stop teasing me so abruptly after all you’ve done?”

32799.synopsis:
Mu Cai was a novice transmigrator who traveled around different worlds. He played the role of cannon fodder in each world.
As we all know, cannon fodders get slapped in the face, ab*sed, and ridiculed by the protagonists.
Mu Cai worked conscientiously and made all the preparations he needed thanks to his seniors’ advice. However, he never expected that the plot of each world would spin out of control!
When he faced the bad-tempered celebrity:
Mu Cai was a bastard that mooched off his brother to get closer to the celebrity he loved. He confidently said, “I love you. Is it wrong to love someone…”
The bad-tempered celebrity, “No, there’s nothing wrong with loving someone. Please marry me!”
Mu Cai, who was prepared beforehand to be beaten black and blue by the celebrity, “???”
When he faced the straight alpha:
Mu Cai pretended to cry, “Although I am not an omega that can carry a cannon on my shoulder like other omegas, I still want to accompany you to the battlefield…”
The straight alpha that disliked seeing people cry and complain, “Baby, it’s not that I don’t want you to come along, it’s just that this is too dangerous. I don’t want you to get hurt, so be obedient and stay home.”
Mu Cai, who was prepared to be reprimanded for crying and complaining, “???”
When he faced the Heavenly Master, who dedicated his life to killing every demon alive:
Mu Cai, as a beautiful and charming spirit that had lived for a millennium, sneered and said, “You abandoned me a thousand years ago, and now you have found your true love after a thousand years. I won’t let the two of you live a happy life!”
The heartless Heavenly Master, “I don’t want to spend the rest of my life with him, I only want you.”
Mu Cai, who was prepared to be captured and killed by the Heavenly Master’s spell, “???”
When he faced the protagonist, who was an innocent college student:
Mu Cai, as the protagonist’s boss, righteously said, “As my plaything, you have to understand…”
The innocent male college student’s eyes glowed with excitement, “Boss, thank you for the dessert.”
Mu Cai, who was pushed onto the bed and was stripped off his clothes, “???”
When he faced the s*um who only loved his white moonlight.
Mu Cai, cried at his one-sided feelings, “Why don’t you love me? Is it because I’m not good enough? Wu wu wu.”
The s*um protagonist was about to speak when he was kicked over by his uncle. The uncle coaxed Mu Cai in a raspy voice, “Baby, please don’t cry. When you cry, I just want to…”
Mu Cai, who was getting married to the scum’s uncle as he sat in the bridal chamber, “???”
Mu Cai: I advised the protagonists to complete their mission, yet all they want to do is dote on me.

34591.synopsis:
The headlines bring shocking and mind-boggling news.

Thankfully, he can still return back to Earth. But the biggest crisis staring down upon him is the open beta scheduled for a year later, and the coming of the players. 
How can he, as a vampire, get strong enough to fight against the oncoming catastrophe incarnates – the players themselves!!

The popular and magnificent ‘crown prince’ was reborn into a disfigured little pathetic girl whom everyone loathes.

“Who made my daughter cry? I’ll twist their neck right away.”

38175.synopsis: Ye Feng wakes up in bed. He touches his face and mutters, “Didn’t I just die in an explosion?” Suddenly he feels a headache and new memories pop into his head. He knows at once he has been reincarnated. Before this, he was a vampire who had lived underground for decades. An explosion at an abandoned factory killed him but now he had a chance to relive his life. Now he doesn’t have to live in the dark anymore. But soon, he finds out that he can’t give up his desire for blood…

38943.synopsis:
Rent Farrant discovered a magic book in his home library when he was a child.
The book was left behind by his ancestor, the legendary great magician, and it contained all kinds of information about magic. Rent read the book and continued his magic training, and became proficient in all kinds of magic.
Eventually, Rent grew up and came to the Magic Academy in the royal capital. He took the entrance exam, but the value that came out when measuring his magic power was,
「Zero magic power.」
Without understanding why, Rent was admitted to the lowest class, Class C. The students there are all failures.
Sarah, even though she comes from a prestigious knight’s family, she was dropped into Class C because of her rebellious attitude towards the examiner.
Diene, from a merchant family, was forced to enroll because she was told to look for a noble husband to make connections.
Muno, from an orphanage, he can’t read and write letters.
While taking classes with them, the principal of the Magic Academy notices Rent’s talent.
「The reason you were considered to have zero magic power was the measurement tool’s fault. Your magic power can’t be measured by modern magic. What you are using is the lost ancient magic.」
Rent, who is the last user of ancient magic, was dropped into the lowest class, Class C, but he decided to teach magic to his classmates.
His classmates are considered failures by the standards of modern magic, but for Rent, they have plenty of room to grow.
In order to get to Class A with all of his classmates, Rent begins his struggle.
associated_names: え、みんな古代魔法使えないの！！？？？ ～魔力ゼロと判定された没落貴族、最強魔法で学園生活を無双する～

41759.synopsis:
Xu Yizhang returned to the age of 23, caressed the platinum ring on her ring finger, and decided to break off her marriage with Han Shen immediately. 
Her mother: “What happened to you and Han Shen? Weren’t you impatient to marry him before?” 
Her father: “The venue and wedding invitations are all ready. Now you’re talking like this? How to solve this problem? Where is the face of your parents?” 
… 
Before she was reborn, Xu Yizhang got married as soon as she graduated. After marriage, Han Shen was so busy that she raised their children alone. 
The group of friends laugh at her and mock her: “Han Shen doesn’t like her at all. She always nags him. As a result, she was given the cold shoulder after marriage and left alone everywhere…” 
After breaking off the marriage, everyone was stunned. “Xu Yizhang broke off an engagement? Why? Does she think the most talented person on campus is not enough for her?”
“Are you crazy? Don’t want such a good man.”
“She probably thinks she is a fairy and wants a match with the Jade Emperor…” 
…
Later. 
Han Shen said: “Xu Yizhang, let’s get married.” 
Xu Yizhang smiled coldly: “Sorry, I don’t want a married life.”
Han Shen: “How can you love someone and not think of marriage?”
Xu Yizhang: “Get lost.”
Han Shen: “What about our previous vows?”
Xu Yizhang: “Count them as idioms.”

43551.synopsis:
My nineteen years of life was taken advantage of by a fake family.

45087.synopsis:
“Please help me.” When a trembling, injured boy makes this desperate plea, the recently transmigrated Arwen can’t turn away. The boy is Shuell Severilous, the male lead in a novel, and Arwen already knows his fate, even though she herself is a nameless figure from its pages.
Determined to save him from his kidnappers and then her own parents, Arwen whisks Shuell back to her home, where Rietta, the female lead, has strangely been adopted by her loving parents. In another turn of events, Arwen is also adopted by the Severilous family, and soon all five live together in a warm and harmonious household when Arwen is doted on by all.
…Until Shuell is no longer a boy but a man. One determined to marry his savior, Arwen. To her, however, his destiny is Rietta, the true female lead, so she rejects him at every turn. Will Arwen be able to fade back into the background, just like in the original novel, or has the plot already changed too much to go back?

45855.synopsis:
An Xian had a crossover from earth to the world of cultivation. As she arrived there, she practised conscientiously and diligently to become a well-known spiritual pharmacist. However, when crossing the final catastrophe, she unknowingly took the wrong medicine, causing her body to undergo abnormal changes and prompting her to fall into a deep slumber. When she finally woke up, it was already 1,800 years later. The world’s civilization had undergone a significant transformation. She also lost her feminine characteristics due to the disaster and the pill, making her unable to cultivate as she used to. She could only draw spiritual power from flowers and plants surrounding her. To use her brand-new identity, she began to grow flowers, open stores, sell medicines, and brainstorm for the future…
The medicine she developed had a miraculous effect on the treatment of mental illness.
The flowers she planted had grand plans to take over the world.
She was a woman who aspired to be a national “male” god.
But she had no idea that the man she had inadvertently picked up was the true male god and that he was about to bend himself for her.

46879.synopsis:
“I have decided not to expect anything from you anymore.”
One day, Norman is told this by his father and was kicked out of the house.
There was no way around it. Because Norman could not use magic at all.

Not to mention, her presence becomes so faint midway through that she’s not even remembered by anyone. That says it all.
Out of all the characters, I’m stuck with this one… Well, I guess I have to live until I die, right?
“Miss Vercia. Aren’t you being a bit too close to Master Fritz?”
There are countless times when I just want to cover my mouth, close my eyes, and shut my ears, but… Fighting, Sue Byron!

86815.synopsis:
Lenore, who didn’t mind if her husband paid her no attention as long as she had the freedom to lie down and read a book, got excited and started talking when Daniel showed interest in her favorite character.
“The Count of Tivonne doesn’t seem like someone who would attract affection. Despite various excuses, he’s ultimately a villain, and the number of people harmed by him is not small.”
Hearing her favorite character being criticized, she closed the door to her heart.
One day, while avoiding her husband whom she deemed an unworthy human being, Daniel suddenly did something strange.
“Your job is to spend all day brushing that silky hair of yours, and then climb into bed before I return….”
He started reciting lines from her favorite character that she had heard many times.
“How dare you sedu-sedu-seduce, no emb-embrace, or-or-or just sleep…!”
He stuttered through his words and then suddenly ran away. When she secretly followed him, she found him banging his head against a wall and lamenting.
“I practiced so hard, why did I freeze up, you idiot…!”
“What do you mean by acting practice?”
Seeing him unable to answer with his ears turning bright red, Lenore realized.
Does this man… like me?

87327.synopsis:
That year, Ling Yueran was eight years old when he met someone even more remarkable than the plum blossoms.
That year, Hua Yuanbai was ten years old when he received a frost-kissed, resilient plum blossom from the young boy he met for the first time.
From then on, they experienced spring flowers, autumn moons, summer rains, and winter snow together.
From then on, they shared candlelight talks through the night, discussing the world.
From then on… in the blink of an eye, ten years passed.

89887.synopsis:
Ten years since I transmigrated.
I realized that I had mistaken the genre.
associated_names: It wasn’t martial arts, it was The Three Kingdoms

91679.synopsis:
Reima Kariya, a summoner who saved another world but was executed because his immense power was deemed a threat, wakes up to find himself back in Japan—the same world he originally came from. However, this Japan is slightly different, as it is now overflowing with dungeons, and the profession of “dungeon streamers” has become highly popular.
Wishing to live a peaceful life in the Japan he has returned to, Reima decides to conceal his powers and blend into this altered modern world…
associated_names: 異世界サモナーダンジョンへ～現代に帰還した俺の召喚獣がどう考えても過剰戦力な件について～

93215.synopsis:
Someone collapsed in front of my house on a rainy day!? I thought and it turned out to be a girl from my class who’s rumored to be a delinquent and a mad dog.
S-She’s indeed scary when she glares… but when you interact with her normally, she’s cute? Mmm, could it be that she doesn’t even realize she’s glaring!?
She treats me as her first friend, but isn’t her sense of distance kind of weird?
She seems to want to be taken care of a lot, like a puppy! She’s a Chihuahua!
associated_names: ヤンキーと恐れられているクラスメイトはただ目つきが悪いだけのチワワでした。

94495.synopsis:
As the white owl descended, it raised its head, not only seeing this bizarre and magnificent world, but also glimpsing the profession modifier it had downloaded before crossing over.
“Consume all experience from the sub-professions [Biomechanical Engineer] , [Mystic Realm Scholar] , and [Special Hypnotist] , converting it into millions of potential points, and use them to fully enhance the main profession [Martial Artist] !”
“I… have obtained the golden ultimate profession, [God of Martial Combat] !”
In the world’s largest metropolitan cluster, on a stormy night.
On the ground, countless killers and martial artists clashed to the death, while swarms of metal mechas and bio-armor erupted in self-destructive explosions. Blood and fire mixed together, everything descending into raw violence and chaos.
Atop a high tower, the white owl stood silently in the dark rain, like a grim and terrifying statue. His scarlet eyes gazed downward, restrained yet bloodthirsty, cold yet tinged with madness.
He leapt down, his trench coat whipping in the wind.
The God of Martial Combat descends upon the final battleground!
A cold voice echoed across the city skyline.
“Next, I will kill everyone present! If you have the strength, come and try to stop me…”
A modern metropolis of luxury and decadence, an era of consumerism obsessed with entertainment.
Beneath the surface of seventy years of peace lies another world of madness and bloodshed.
Martial artists who have mastered secret techniques from various schools clash with killers controlled by combat modes, each locked in a brutal, endless battle.
Metal mechas brimming with terrifying energy, bio-armor derived from monster cells—the brutal struggle between old and new technologies has begun.
In this age warped by machinery and alien forces, calling out for the unique power of humanity might be an unimaginable kind of romance…

95007.synopsis:
Tang Yu transmigrates into the world of an urban power fantasy novel, taking on the role of a second-generation wealthy villain blessed with a system that rewards him for surviving through plot arcs! His plan? Lay low, avoid trouble, and survive until the story’s end.
First step: cancel the engagement to avoid being killed by the Dragon King!
However, things don’t go as planned. Everyone around him seems to be acting, determined to stir up trouble and paint a target on his back:
Su Muyue: “You want to cancel the engagement? No, you don’t.”
Future father-in-law: “Who does Ye Chen think he is? My son-in-law can only be Tang Yu!”
Head bodyguard: “Young Master Tang has been so kind to me; I’ll kill the Dragon King for him!”
No matter how hard Tang Yu tries to stay out of the plot, someone always steps in to escalate the conflict.
To stay safe, Tang Yu has no choice but to crush the Dragon King himself.
PS: A lighthearted, comedic villain story filled with absurd twists and laughs!
associated_names: After Listening to What Inside My Mind the Female Leads Want to Flung Into My Harem
反派：女主偷听我心声人设崩了

95519.synopsis:
A savior who can’t act isn’t a good extraordinary being. Can I call myself a drama king just because I invest in the crew and rewrite the script? That’s called fatherly love~
After rejecting the industry’s unspoken rules and facing failure in the entertainment world, Sheng Yixia, who was about to be forced to return home to inherit a fortune, broke up with his girlfriend and awakened the “Post-Film, Draw Character Superpower Cards” system. From then on, he swept through the entertainment industry, overturned the world of superpowers, and fought to protect the world and uphold peace.
Eldritch gods, foreign demons, and star realm spirits tremble: “Sheng Yixia, don’t come near us, we’ll just leave! Is that enough?”
After obtaining a complete character card, he must role-play the character in real life to reach the peak.
Character Card 1: [Magician] : Every battle is a grand and magnificent magic performance, and I will turn the tides.
Character Card 2: [Soul Singer] : I redeem the world with my songs, soothe the masses, and shatter the demon gods.
Character Card 3: [Mechanical Mentor] : Flesh is weak; only machines ascend. Join my sect, and you will enjoy eternal life.
Character Card 4…
(The order of the character cards does not reflect the order in the novel.)
associated_names: 杀青后，我觉醒了超能力

96799.synopsis:
Yu Li transmigrated into a retro novel as the male protagonist’s fiancée, who had been caught in an affair and tragically ended her life in humiliation. Upon waking up, she discovered the harsh reality: after tirelessly caring for the male protagonist’s family, he had already been having an affair with her best friend. To get rid of her, his family schemed to frame her for sleeping with his comrade-in-arms, leading to her disgrace.
Yu Li, unable to endure it any longer, retaliated by beating up the male protagonist’s vile mother, exposing his true colors, and decisively marrying the innocent soldier comrade! But little did she expect that the handsome and refined soldier, once the lights went out, would show a very different side. By day, he was a doting husband willing to do anything for her, but by night, he reclaimed all his love with interest…
Xiao Yuying, jealous of her best friend Yu Li’s promising engagement, secretly seduced Yu Li’s fiancé. However, Yu Li boldly broke off the engagement and married the soldier Lu Guanshan, who was rumored to have a short life expectancy. Familiar with the future plot, Xiao Yuying waited for Lu Guanshan to die so Yu Li would end up a widow. Yet she kept waiting, only to see Lu Guanshan rise through the ranks, reconnect with his powerful parents, and shower Yu Li with love. Meanwhile, Yu Li became a successful businesswoman, gained fame after giving birth to twins, and even topped the national college entrance exam!
In contrast, Xiao Yuying’s stolen husband ended up crippled, impotent, and utterly ruined. Consumed with jealousy, she spiraled into madness. She was supposed to be the protagonist—so why was Yu Li living such a perfect life?
associated_names: 被闺蜜抢亲，嫁军官怀双胎躺赢了

98591.synopsis:
Zhan Yan had always thought of himself as an ordinary person from an ordinary family, adopted by an ordinary family, and bound to an ordinary gossip system.
Until one day, when his gentle and reliable father came home smelling strongly of perfume.
Zhan Yan suspiciously opened the gossip system:
【The Demon King of the Wan Yao (Ten Thousand Demon) Alliance, Zhan Yunkai, accidentally got pollen from the corpse flower devil’s yam while chasing a traitor. To prevent his wife and child from finding out, he took seven baths and used up an entire bottle of perfume before coming home.】
Zhan Yan: Eyes shaking in disbelief!
Then one day, his elegant and beautiful mother didn’t come home by midnight and didn’t answer her phone.
Zhan Yan, worried, opened the gossip system:
【Top combatant of the Abnormal Affairs Management Bureau, Ji Yueming, got trapped in a maze after forgetting the password when leaving the bureau’s secret area. To get home quickly, she is angrily tearing down the maze.】
Zhan Yan: ???
Wait a minute! Isn’t the Abnormal Affairs Management Bureau an enemy organization of the Wan Yao Alliance?!
Zhan Yan frantically searched the gossip system and finally found where the two met:
【Zhan Yunkai fell in love with Ji Yueming at first sight during the Lantern Festival and decided to hide his identity to date and marry her.】
【Ji Yueming fell in love with Zhan Yunkai at first sight during the Lantern Festival and decided to hide her identity to date and marry him.】
Zhan Yan: Wow! You both are wearing fake identities, huh?!
The harmonious and happy family is facing a crisis of breaking apart, and Zhan Yan is very worried. He starts frantically searching the gossip system to see if there’s any information that can help make everyone friends instead of enemies.
Then, he discovers that his older brother, Zhan Jinli, is the reincarnation of the Ghost King, and his second sister, Zhan Suiyu, is a superpowered person who came back from the apocalypse. Everyone thinks the others are ordinary people, and they are all trying to hide their true selves to maintain this ordinary and happy family.
·
Zhan Yan has a boyfriend, Gu Jiancheng, who is handsome, has a good personality, but is a bit clingy.
Recently, Zhan Yan has been busy trying to save his crumbling family, so he’s been neglecting his boyfriend.
Gu Jiancheng brings up their previous agreement to meet his parents.
Zhan Yan hesitates: “How about we forget it?”
Gu Jiancheng, heartbroken: “Why? Do you not love me anymore?”
Zhan Yan: “No, it’s just that things are a bit complicated right now.”
To divert his boyfriend’s attention, Zhan Yan starts looking up Gu Jiancheng’s gossip:
【Gu Jiancheng, feeling upset, brutally killed a hundred monsters that entered the real world from the Infinite World.】
Zhan Yan slowly lowers his head to look at Gu Jiancheng.
Gu Jiancheng hugs his waist and doesn’t let go, rubbing his shoulder with a grievance: “Yan Yan, you’ve been so cold to me lately. You didn’t even give me a goodnight kiss last night.”
associated_names: 吃瓜发现我全家皆大佬

100127.synopsis:
Son Jinhyuk, a man celebrated by the public for his remarkable success, longed for a simple life with his cherished family. Despite the accolades, his heart remained heavy with loneliness.
One fateful day, an accident transported him back in time to when he was just 9 years old, before the tragic loss of his parents—whom he had yearned for so deeply.
Now, with a second chance at life, can Jinhyuk save his parents and achieve the ordinary life he always desired?
associated_names: The Genius Wants to be Ordinary!

100383.synopsis:
“I saw your fiancé courting a widow.”
One day, Kisa heard shocking words from a stranger. Pale with shock, she went to confront him and asked,
“The difference in gender between her and me is merely a secondary factor. Am I, in blunt terms, having an affair?”
Kisa could no longer endure this deception.
**
Before her, who was struggling with an oppressive father over the broken engagement, a man appeared like a savior—Seyard, who suddenly became a duke in place of his deceased brother.
“Kisa, will you marry me? To solve each other’s problems.”
A suspicious man with nothing known about him. However, he was kind, and unlike her father, he supported her.
Sometimes, an inexplicable chill overcame her, but everything went smoothly. Until a letter arrived from her former fiancé.
[I have something urgent to tell you. It’s a very serious and dangerous issue regarding the man who may become your husband.] 
Kisa’s heart raced. What is this man hiding from me?
associated_names: If You Desire To Keep Me

100639.synopsis:
I saved the protagonist’s teacher, who was my best friend in my previous life and whose death was confirmed.
But.
– What complete incompetence… I guess it’s right to destroy the empire.
Hey, teacher?

101151.synopsis:
In a quiet suburban town, a family that once seemed perfect is falling apart.
The mother’s secret affair shakes the foundation of their home, leaving everyone hurt and confused.
The middle school daughter, burdened by her own struggles, feels the weight of her mother’s betrayal.
The father, heartbroken yet determined, tries to pick up the pieces.
As their world crumbles, each of them searches for meaning, hope, and a new way to move forward.
Amid the pain, they slowly begin to discover that happiness can take on a different shape—a form they never expected.
associated_names: シアワセノカタチ　～母親の不倫によって崩壊していく家族、傷ついた中学生の娘と苦悩する父親が新しい幸せの形を見出すまで～

101919.synopsis:
“What will happen to my existence if I return to Earth?” Considering that my existence would disappear, I wrote a farewell letter in advance. 
Then the female lead, who I wasn’t on good terms with, secretly infiltrated my room and discovered it.
associated_names: The Heroine Found My Sui**de Note (Novelpia Global)
The Woman Found the Will I Wrote

103455.synopsis:
Because he was a genius, he drowned in his own arrogance—until he realized his shortcomings and put in the effort.
Lloyd Reinhardt. That name belonged to a villainous noble in the game Arcana of the Sword Demon.
Blessed with extraordinary talent beyond human comprehension, Lloyd succumbed to his own abilities, becoming conceited and overconfident. Drunk on his own superiority, he eventually turned to crime, only to meet his end at the hands of the protagonist—an inevitable downfall for a villainous noble.
And then, there was one unfortunate boy who found himself reincarnated as Lloyd.
“Well, I just have to avoid committing any crimes, right?”
Even if he had been reborn as a villainous noble, as long as he didn’t become arrogant or engage in criminal acts, he should be fine. He knew better—after all, he had been just an ordinary high school student in his past life.
“Alright! Time to make the most of my noble status. Dad, I’m going to start buying female s*aves and build myself a harem!”
associated_names: 悪役貴族に転生した僕は緩くハーレムを生活を送りたい～ゲーム本編には関わらず、女奴隷を囲って悠々自適に暮らしたいのに周りが僕を英雄扱いしてくるのだが～

108319.synopsis:
Alois Montherlant is the third prince of the Kingdom of Urthoriet, but after meeting a certain someone one day, he remembers a bit of what people might call his “previous life.” In that world, Urthoriet was part of a popular story, and the certain someone he just met used to be his favorite character in that story.
Knowing an unlucky future is waiting for his favorite, Damien Cousteau, he vows to make Damien happy somehow…
associated_names: その子は幸せにするので私にください！

108575.synopsis:
Mu Tao is the female protagonist of a Xianxia novel. Born with demonic bones, yet raised in a celestial mountain, her first half of life is a collection of classic tropes of ab*sed and heartbroken heroines.
The respected master treats her coldly, the beloved male lead is ruthless towards her, and in this vast world, no one shows her an ounce of kindness.
One day, she snaps, slaying her master with her sword, humiliating the male lead beneath her feet, settling old scores one by one, and leading an army of one hundred thousand demons to conquer the three realms.
After finishing the novel, Li Yu felt a surge of satisfaction: “This world isn’t worth it, she should have turned evil sooner. The righteous are so hypocritical; being a villain is much more liberating!”
Unexpectedly, with a blink of an eye, she transmigrated into this very novel, becoming the righteous master of this villainous female lead—Li Yu.
Kneeling before her was a young girl, around sixteen or seventeen years old.
Her apricot-like eyes were slightly red, filled with stubborn tears. Her pointed ears and fluffy tail drooped dejectedly.
Is this the future demoness who will strike her down with a sword?
—She retracted her previous words.
A child… it’s better to raise her to be obedient and clingy.
This master will guide her with love…

112671.synopsis:
An idol, Do Yoon-Jae, trapped in a world that endlessly repeats unless he acts according to the script.
The moment he abandons the goals he achieved as a puppet,
a new opportunity appears!
“If this is what being an idol is, I’m out.”
[Then, what is your true wish?] 
“To live however the hell I want.”
His one and only goal:
to live life on his own terms and then move on!
Do Yoon-Jae’s journey to achieve his very own ending,
driven by a desperate desire for freedom, begins now!

115999.synopsis:
Angels do exist, and he grows Shine Muscat grapes.
The story of a farmer who was seriously cultivating Shine Muscat grapes when he suddenly found himself transported to 16th century America.
associated_names: 1588: I Retired to Farm Shine Muscats, But It's the New World
1588: Moved to Farm Shine Muscat, Discovered a New World

117279.synopsis:
Transported to a Western fantasy world, I became a noble with garbage-tier aptitude. Although I awakened a talent that lets me draw a lottery every day, most of the stuff I pulled was pure junk. Hecate had already mentally prepared to lie flat and mooch off the family forever.
But unexpectedly, the lottery talent drew the Witch Seed.
Every gift from fate has its price clearly marked.
The moment he chose the Witch Seed, his affinity with magic hit the maximum. Just breathing in a bit of air would boost his power.
But the cost was…
associated_names: 一天一抽奖，把自己抽成魔女

118303.synopsis:
Famous author Xu Yeyu has been in a creative slump for the past two years. She hasn’t been able to write a full-length novel ever since an incident at her family’s vineyard — a day when her cousin, also a writer, suffered a worsening of his depression after a mysterious event involving her.
Her aunt accused her of jealousy and deliberately triggering the breakdown. But Xu Yeyu had been drunk that day and couldn’t remember a thing.
To clear her name and find writing inspiration, she moves to L City. Hoping to help her cousin and write a novel about psychology to raise awareness about depression, she begins auditing evening lectures taught by renowned psychology professor Lu Yanbai.
By accident, she impersonates someone else and gets randomly called on in class — and so begins their comedic, tender “make-up lesson” journey.
Through shared misunderstandings, late-night writing, and unexpected sparks, romance begins to blossom. Eventually, Lu Yanbai discovers she’s not really his student, but by then… he already likes her.
Excerpt · · · · · ·
At first, Xu Yeyu attended Professor Lu Yanbai’s evening lecture as an observer. She noticed her friend eating an apple during class.
Her professional instincts kicked in: “According to the rules of novels, when the professor notices you, he’ll first scan you up and down with his beautiful eyes, then call out your name in a sexy, low voice, and finally say, ‘Come to my office after class.’”
Friend: “What will it take for you to shut up?”
Xu Yeyu: “I just want a bite.”
As she took her first bite of the apple, Lu Yanbai appeared next to her.
His deep, captivating peach-blossom eyes swept over her notebook.
“Xu Yeyu?” The man spoke her name in a low, husky voice, tapping his fingers on her desk. With a cold tone, he said, “Come to my office after class.”
Xu Yeyu: ……
Later, Xu Yeyu went to her boyfriend’s class to write a novel.
Her friend asked, “Your Professor Lu is such a cultured rogue—don’t you want to write something about him?”
Outside the window, the night was thick, and the moon hung low on the branches.
Xu Yeyu thought it was a good idea, inspiration flowing like a fountain. After writing a thousand words, she went to the restroom. When she returned, she found that someone had already finished reading those thousand words. His dark eyes were unreadable.
Finally, the man calmly, yet with hidden turbulence, said in a serious tone: “… Come to my office after class.”
#Xu Yeyu: O…Okay?#
A dramatic flair x well-mannered beast
Life is bitter for everyone, but my story is sweet.

120607.synopsis:
My name’s Su Ran. Full-blooded man, through and through.
So why the hell did I get a Witch System?
[As a fellow witch, please assist the newly awakened witch Isa in escaping the Hounds.
Reward: 1x Witch’s Healing Potion.] 
Flat on my back, unable to move, I peek under the blanket at my trusty little bro…
Then glance at Isa’s finely rendered model in the system.
And just like that, it hits me—
This is a gender-bender plot, isn’t it!?
associated_names: 不好！我成了魔女们的病弱白月光

120863.synopsis:
After dealing with one terrible guide after another, Jihyun finally snaps and declares he’ll no longer accept a paired guide.
Five years later, the upper agency offers him yet another match. Ready to refuse again, Jihyun is caught off guard when the new candidate, a clean-cut and handsome man named Sangwoo, declares it was love at first sight—and refuses to back down.
Still haunted by the emotional scars from previous guides, Jihyun is reluctant to trust Sangwoo.
But little by little, Sangwoo’s sincerity begins to break through Jihyun’s walls.
Just as Jihyun finally begins to think this time might be different, Sangwoo’s behavior begins to raise new questions—for different reasons.

121887.synopsis:
After their parents passed away, Haejin, exhausted both physically and mentally from his older brother’s ab*se, encounters a man who visits their home due to a problem caused by his brother. The man, seeing Haejin’s obvious signs of ab*se, extends a strange form of kindness, and Haejin falls for him at first sight.  
The man kills Haejin’s brother and, in place of the “meat price” he takes, gives Haejin a “black card,” which Haejin uses to sustain himself.  
With the brother he considered a monster now dead, Haejin finds peace and begins to see the man as a savior, developing a blind affection for him. However, the man seems to give Haejin hope while simultaneously keeping him at a distance…

123167.synopsis:
Human mage Mo Li was forced to self-detonate in the final battle against the demons, but was taken home by the Demon God Emperor who arrived afterward, becoming a silver-haired, red-eyed demon princess.
And it all traced back to a year ago, during the mission to subjugate the Demon God Galil.
The army Mo Li led was ambushed during the march and completely annihilated. In the end, Mo Li prepared to self-destruct and take the demons down with him.
But after the explosion, he didn’t die, instead, he was taken back to the Demon City Palace by the faraway Demon God Emperor and turned into a baby-voiced little demon princess.
“Why did I become like this? Where’s my body? Give it back to me!?”
“Eh~ I don’t know, since you’re here, just stay put, my dear daughter~ Come, let me hold you.”
“Go away! I don’t want to! You’re old enough to be my great-grandmother!”
The next second, a bump appeared on Li Bao’s head.
After becoming the little demon princess, Mo Li tried every possible method to escape, whether with cake spoons, forks, or even digging with her hands, but was always caught and brought back.
“Stop wasting your energy, little Li Bao.”
“I will never submit to you! I’m going to escape, even if you beat me to death!”
“Sigh, want some of my cream puff, Li Bao?”
“I want to eat—no, I don’t want it!”
“Call me Mother and I’ll give it to you.”
“M-Mother…”
After 49 days of sincere motherly guidance, Li Bao turned from absolute resistance into the current tsundere yet physically honest little white-haired bun.
associated_names: 人类魔法师怎么会是魔神皇的女儿

123423.synopsis:
In the year 1572—seventy-two years before the fall of the Ming dynasty and the loss of its lands—southeastern pirates ravage the coast while Tartar forces press the northwest; local warlords carve out fiefdoms, the army and government are exhausted, and the common people suffer. The Longqing Emperor has just passed away.
At that moment, Shi Yue transmigrates into the body of Zhu Yijun—the future Wanli Emperor—who has spent thirty years without attending court.
The good news: Zhu Yijun has not yet ascended the throne, so he has not yet had the chance to bring disaster to the government.
The bad news: Zhu Yijun has not yet ascended the throne.
Feng Bao, the Seal-holding Director of the Directorate of Ceremonial, plans to act as the spokesperson for imperial power.
Senior Grand Secretary Gao Gong wants to sideline the emperor and strengthen the cabinet.
Grand Secretary Zhang Juzheng is intent on ruling wholeheartedly and pushing through new reforms.
His only hope lies with his birth mother, Lady Li—who still forces him to kneel in punishment and compels him to draft self-criticisms.
With the dynasty’s fate hanging in the balance and ruthless power struggles unfolding at the highest levels, how will he, destined to become a “wise ruler,” survive—and shape—the coming storm?

133663.synopsis:
In the Nigel Empire, there exists a rare innate trait known as “Alpha” and “Omega,” passed down only to its people. However, such traits have become a thing of the past, with individuals born possessing them becoming exceedingly rare.
Yet by some twist of fate, three young men destined to lead the next generation—the Crown Prince, the eldest son of a Duke’s family, and the second son of a Marquis’s family—are all determined to have the Alpha trait.
To ensure the safety of not only his son but also the sons of his close and trusted friends, the Emperor personally begins searching for any information regarding the Alpha trait.
Eventually, his search leads him to an Omega named “Aileen.”
From that day forward, Aileen becomes the wife of the Crown Prince, the spouse of the Duke’s eldest son, and the mate of the Marquis’s second son. Her life changes completely, taking a path unlike anything she had ever imagined.

133919.synopsis:
“Hello.”
The moment I blurted out the greeting, my mind went blank.
Are we on “hello” terms?
“…to you.”
Kwon Jeongheon, an executive at M Holdings and a man known as the ‘dog’ of Haeshin Group,
encounters Go Wooyeon, a gallerist, after 11 years at a gallery.
“How far can you go?”
His distinct black eyes were fixed on Wooyeon.
The strange question and his sharp, penetrating gaze made her feel as if she were stripped bare.
“I heard you can get anything you want here.”
Her first love, which had a bitter end, suddenly reappeared and shook Wooyeon’s world.
Unlike the time when she was so in love she didn’t notice summer burning or autumn fading,
he stood before her, clearly holding the gap between nineteen and thirty-one.
《Even More》

148511.synopsis:
The Devil, Notte, who devoured the young and handsome Duke Conrad.
The Exorcist, Elena, who appeared before him.
“I am a merciful devil. Instead of completely devouring the poor Duke, I merely took his nights. Nevertheless, if you wish to drive me out….”
The price the Devil demanded from her was…….
“Hand over your hundred nights.”
A hundred nights.
Elena willingly accepted the deal.
“Get on the bed and spread your legs. I’ll take the first night immediately.”
Wearing the Duke’s skin, the Devil burrowed between her legs.
* * *
“Haa. Elena. How many days are left now?”
“Ugh, hnnngh…….”
“I look forward to the remaining nights as well.”
Notte, savoring the lingering sensation of climax, kissed Elena’s cheek. Soon after, the man’s eyes lost their red glow and found their original green color. It was the signal that the body’s true owner, Duke Conrad, was awakening. But then…….
“Agh!”
“I’m sorry, Miss Elena.”
The formerly affectionate man now occupied the space below, where the Devil had relentlessly explored all night.
“Please…… do not forgive me.”
It was the start of yet another night.

166175.synopsis:
It has been nearly six years since I shut myself away in my room.
My only pleasure in life was watching and reviewing creative works like dramas and movies. Then one day, I gained the Role Synchronization ability, which allowed me to synchronize with the characters from the works I had seen.
Suddenly, a bolt from the blue struck my private paradise.
That ability began to threaten me.

Would you choose the same path and the same love if you could live your life all over again?
Arisugawa Masahito, a forty-one-year-old third-rate musician. On the night his ex-wife Miyako told him she wanted a divorce, he woke up to find himself back at fifteen. He decided to keep his distance from Miyako and stay away from the path of music, only for his hidden musical talent to blossom—!?
